Common.title: On-chain Tic-Tac-Toe
Common.description: A tic-tac-toe game that runs entirely in a smart contract. Both players stake the same amount and the winner takes the pot. Testnets only.

escrow.title: The contract holds the stakes
escrow.body: Both players send the same amount when they join, and the contract escrows it. There is no path for an operator to walk away with the funds.

judge.title: The chain decides the winner
judge.body: The board and the win check live inside the contract. There is no server and no database.

timeout.title: Stalling cannot trap your money
timeout.body: If the player to move runs out the clock, the opponent claims the pot by forfeit. Funds are never stuck.

Footer.testnetNotice: Testnets only. The ETH used here has no monetary value.

Play.title: Lobby
Play.description: Create a game or join an open one. Stakes are escrowed by the contract and claimed by the winner.
Play.connectPrompt: Connect a wallet to create or join a game.

solo.title: Play the contract
solo.description: Practice against an opponent written into the contract. No stakes — you only pay gas.
solo.explainer: Your opponent is a procedure written in Solidity. When you move, it computes its reply inside the same transaction. Tic-tac-toe is a solved game, so Hard cannot be beaten: a draw is the best you can do.

levelHint.easy: Takes a win if one is offered, otherwise plays at random. It will not defend.
levelHint.normal: Sees wins and immediate losses only. Build a fork — two threats at once — and you can beat it.
levelHint.hard: The full strategy. An exhaustive test proves it never loses.

solo.drawIsBest: A draw against Hard is the best result there is. Perfect play on both sides always ends here.
solo.noContract: No practice contract is configured for the connected network.

history.title: History
history.description: Every game your address took part in, assembled from the contracts' event logs.
history.explainer: This list is not a database. It comes from the events the contracts emitted, narrowed by their indexed topics. Reading needs no signature, so the same page works for any address.
history.connectPrompt: Connect a wallet to see your history.
history.devWithExplorer: Each transaction hash links out to the block explorer.
history.devNoExplorer: A local Anvil node has no block explorer, so the transaction hash is shown as-is instead of a link.

txlog.withExplorer: Events emitted by the contract. Transaction hashes link to {explorer}.
txlog.noExplorer: Events emitted by the contract. A local chain has no explorer, so hashes are shown as-is.

chain.title: The blocks that carried this game
chain.explainer: Every block names its predecessor by hash. Change one bit of an old block and its hash changes, breaking every link after it. That is what “immutable” actually means.
chain.footnote: These hashes were read from the chain itself, not computed by this page.
chain.empty: No events for this game yet.

faucet.title: This wallet holds no test ether on this network
faucet.body: You cannot pay for gas yet. Get some from a faucet — each one asks for something different.
